memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time. - Gen 6:5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This is one of the most sobering verses in all of Scripture, and it goes right to the root. God does not merely see wicked actions; He sees the wicked heart behind them. "Every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time." Every, only, all - there are no exceptions and no breaks. The problem was not on the surface; it was in the very core of the human being.

This is the Bible's honest diagnosis of our condition apart from God. Sin is not just a matter of bad deeds we could stop if we tried harder. It flows from a heart that is bent away from God from the inside out. Jesus said the same thing: "out of the heart come evil thoughts" (Matt 15:19). We do not sin because of our circumstances; we sin because of our hearts.

This truth humbles us. We cannot fix ourselves by mere self-improvement, because the problem lies deeper than behaviour.

But this dark diagnosis is exactly why the gospel is such good news. God does not merely ask us to try harder; He promises a new heart. "I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you" (Ezek 36:26). What we could never do, God does - He changes us from the inside through Christ. Our only hope is not better behaviour but a new heart, and that is precisely what God offers.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you see sin as a heart problem, not just a behaviour problem?
- Have you asked God for the new heart only He can give?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I confess that my problem goes deeper than my actions - it is my heart. Thank You for the new heart You give in Christ. Renew me from the inside out.
